nl: Rename every .jpeg file in site/img/ to the extension .jpg and update the src attributes in the HTML files under site/ that refer to them (hero, team and office2). Do not change other text.
oracle_program:
find "site/img" glob: "*.jpeg" |> rename /\.jpeg$/ ".jpg"
search /(src="img\/[^"]+)\.jpeg"/ "site" glob: "*.html" |> replace "${1}.jpg\""
reference_bash:
for f in site/img/*.jpeg; do mv -- "$f" "${f%.jpeg}.jpg"; done
sed -i -E 's/(src="img\/[^"]+)\.jpeg"/\1.jpg"/g' site/*.html

negatives.script:
for f in site/img/*.jpeg; do mv -- "$f" "${f%.jpeg}.jpg"; done
sed -i 's/\.jpeg/.jpg/g' site/*.html
negatives.defect: also rewrites the prose that mentions .jpeg
